name: Malapert Massif
description: 41 x 41 km around the Malapert Massif (Artemis candidate region): its summit, ~5 km above the lunar datum, faces the Earth and sees far more sunlight than the surrounding lowlands, while slopes behind it lose the Earth entirely.

sites.name: Malapert Massif (Site 23)
sites.note: PGDA 5 m site ROI centre (Lunar Surface Data Book Table A2-2); Artemis candidate region.

sites.name: Malapert summit
sites.note: Highest terrain within 8 km of Site 23 in LOLA LDEM_85S_40M (5173 m).

sites.name: Malapert lower slope
sites.note: Lowest terrain 3 km from the summit in LOLA LDEM_85S_40M (4612 m): a slope facing away from Earth.

sites.name: Crater floor near Malapert
sites.note: Lowest terrain within 12 km of the summit in LOLA LDEM_85S_40M (743 m).
